correctness.rationale: The classification theorem supplies the finite decomposition. Finiteness makes the Boolean ring unital and hence a product of copies of F_2. The intrinsic commuting/left/right leaves force every automorphism to split coordinatewise. The commutative coordinate is then a ring automorphism because the unique multiplicative absorber is fixed; the two heap coordinates are arbitrary affine automorphisms. The converse is immediate from the product operations. Exhaustive checks on five small models agree with the formula.

value.rationale: Automorphism groups are a canonical structural invariant immediately adjacent to an isomorphism classification. The formula converts the new Boolean-truss decomposition into exact symmetry data for every finite example and separates ring-atom permutations from affine heap symmetries.
